name: agent-progress-ui
description: Open-source React UI system for long-running AI tasks and agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,react,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @agent-progress-ui/core" "npm run dev --workspace @agent-progress-ui/react" "npm run dev --workspace @agent-progress-ui/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agent-progress-ui/core && npm run build --workspace @agent-progress-ui/react && npm run build --workspace @agent-progress-ui/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @agent-progress-ui/core && npm run lint --workspace @agent-progress-ui/react && npm run lint --workspace @agent-progress-ui/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-progress-ui/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-progress-ui/react && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-progress-ui/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @agent-progress-ui/core && npm run test --workspace @agent-progress-ui/web
